messages:
Maya S: Heads-up: staging promote failed healthchecks, deploybot reports artifact size mismatch for api-server-2.4.0.tar.gz
deploybot: promote aborted: artifact metadata mismatch for gs://redwood-builds/api-server-2.4.0.tar.gz (size: expected 18,242,112 bytes, found 8,421,760 bytes)
Jordan L: Oh no. That looks like a truncated upload. CI job shows uploader finished successfully though.
Maya S: Staging tests show strange import failures and missing static files after extract.
QA-bot: staging-canary-3 failed: http 500 on /health at 2025-11-03T14:22:30Z
Lee (release-lead): Change window closes in 2h. Should we hold and pin to 2.3.9 (last good) or try a quick rebuild?
Jordan L: Recommend pin to 2.3.9 to avoid overrunning the window. I'll open a rollback PR to pin the helm chart imageTag and CI manifest.
Maya S: Agree. We can rebuild 2.4.0+hotfix in parallel and validate offline. If it passes, schedule a follow-up promote outside this window.
deploybot: Note: automatic promote retried 2 times. Last attempt at 14:24:10Z
Jordan L: I'll also patch CI uploader to check uploaded object length against local file before marking publish step success.
Maya S: Can we add a short safety check in deploybot to compare registry digest with artifact manifest before allowing promote?
sre-bot: Incident created INC-2026-062: truncated artifact upload during publish. Assigned to eng-infra and release team.
Jordan L: PR submitted: github.com/redwood/helm-charts/compare/pin-api-2.3.9 (WIP) - tagging @Lee for urgent approval
Lee (release-lead): Reviewing now. Also notify Product and Customer Success that the mainline release is on hold.
Maya S: I'll draft the release-hold message and ping #release-notifications. Short note: "Hold: api-server 2.4.0 promote blocked by artifact integrity issue; pinning to 2.3.9 to preserve change window. Follow-up deploy scheduled after rebuild and validation"
QA-bot: adding test-run note: re-run smoke after new artifact validated (manual)
Jordan L: Temporary mitigation: point the package index alias for "api-server:latest" to 2.3.9 until fixed to avoid accidental pulls.
Maya S: After PR merged and helm imageTag pinned, manual promote will be executed by release lead. No DB migrations in this release so safe to pin.
Lee (release-lead): Approved PR; merging and will kick manual promote once merged. Leaving auto-promote disabled for this pipeline until we verify uploader fix.
Jordan L: Will follow up with a CI hotfix and a short postmortem checklist to add to release playbook about verifying artifact size and sha256 before mark-as-published.
Maya S: Thanks all. I'll update #release-war-room and mark the change window as preserved. :white_check_mark:
